title: linum usitatissimum subsp. vulgare
intro: Linum usitatissimum subsp. vulgare, commonly known as common flax, is a subspecies of the flax plant, a member of the family Linaceae. It is a versatile plant that has been utilized for its nutritional and medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and providing essential omega-3 fatty acids. The therapeutic actions of common flax include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties, making it effective in treating conditions like eczema, arthritis, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of common flax include lignans, flavonoids, and essential fatty acids, particularly alpha-linolenic acid (ALA), which contribute to its medicinal properties.
